name: epic-infographics
description: Create polished, scene-first infographic images from data, facts, or a topic — social graphics, stats posters, story/reel visuals, print one-pagers, link-preview banners — as a self-contained HTML/CSS+SVG page rendered to PNG. Ten fully-specified design languages (blueprint, dark-glass, naturalist-plate, isometric-world, retro-print, editorial, hand-drawn, swiss, corporate-clean, neo-brutalist), six canvas presets from square social to A4 print, a rich data vocabulary, computed-never-eyeballed chart geometry, colorblind-validated palettes, and a mandatory render–review–fix loop where the agent inspects its own PNG before delivering.

interface.shortDescription: Infographics that don't look AI-made — scene-first images, brief in, PNG out.
